Federal Investment in Basic Research: a Timeline

Reading the timeline. This is a primer of the major events that shaped federal investment in basic research. The events are organized by date and roughly divided by type: new institutions, policy and law, major funding actions, external shocks, milestone discoveries, and influential assessments. Events selected are highlights and not intended to be exhaustive. Before 1940 the timeline is truncated with ellipses showing the years removed. The riverine chart after 1953 shows federal obligations for basic research by agency, in constant 2017 dollars. Click an icon in the legend to filter by type of event. Journeys filter the timeline to a single theme; an event can appear in more than one.

Funding Series Sources. Total federal obligations from the NSF Survey of Federal Funds for R&D, volumes 4 to 17, 73, and 74; NSF 24-332, Analysis of Federal Funding for R&D in 2022: Basic Research; CRS Report 95-1209, Federal R&D Funding: A Concise History. Constant 2017 dollars calculated from 2026 OMB Historical Table 10.1. FY2025 data are preliminary. Restated NASA basic research amounts for FYs 1954 to 1966 are estimated from residuals.
